slides.title: How to order the rich 'kotteri' bowl
slides.dek: Tenkaippin, Akihabara. No Japanese needed, just four things to know.

slides.title: Order on the tablet
slides.body: It has English labels. Kotteri is the rich one, assari the light one.
Garlic and chili are already in the bowl. Don't want them? Say this when you order.

slides.title: Add a plate of fried rice
slides.body: Yu's add-on with the kotteri bowl.

lines: ニンニク抜きで = without garlic
